# TimelineDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A narrative timeline along a decorative path (**not** date-accurate — that is `UltraCanvasTimelineChart`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
TimelineDiagramStyle CreateForDesign(TimelineDesign design);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram> CreateTimelineDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram> CreateTimelineDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, TimelineDesign design);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram> CreateTimelineDiagramWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const std::vector<TimelineItem>& items, TimelineDesign design);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTimelineDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `TimelineDesign`

Geometry presets. Every design renders the same item list; they differ in how the spine is drawn and where item content is placed.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Bar` | Horizontal spine split into colored segments, nodes alternating on its edges |
| `Line` | Thin horizontal axis, nodes on the axis, content on one side |
| `Alternating` | Thin axis with content cards zigzagging above and below |
| `Cards` | Row of separate cards with colored headers, no decorative spine |
| `Vertical` | Top-down spine with content cards left and right |
| `Serpentine` | Snaking ribbon wrapping over several runs |
| `Hanging` | Axis on top, stems dropping to bubbles of varying size |
| `Chevron` | Sequence of arrow blocks pointing forward |
| `Steps` | Ascending staircase blocks |
| `Wave` | Chain of half-rings bending alternately, nodes where two meet |

### enum `TimelineNodeShape`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Circle` |  |
| `RoundedSquare` |  |
| `Square` |  |
| `Diamond` |  |
| `Hexagon` |  |
| `Pin` | Map-pin / teardrop pointing at the spine |
| `Hidden` | No node marker ("None" is an X11 macro) |

### enum `TimelineSidePolicy`

Which side of the spine an item's content is placed on. "Above" means left for the vertical design, "Below" means right. For the wave design "Above" is the side up (and to the right, on a falling diagonal) of the direction the wave runs in: the side its half-ring bulges to.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Alternate` | Zigzag: item 0 above, item 1 below, ... |
| `AllAbove` |  |
| `AllBelow` |  |
| `PerItem` | Use TimelineItem::side (0 falls back to Alternate) |

### enum `TimelineColorMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PerItem` | Each item takes the next palette entry |
| `Single` | Everything uses the first palette entry |
| `GradientAlongPath` | Spine is a gradient from the first to the last color |

### enum `TimelinePlacement`

How item positions along the spine are computed.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Even` | Evenly spaced - time is not to scale (the usual infographic) |
| `Proportional` | Spaced by TimelineItem::dateSerial, with a minimum gap |

### enum `TimelineConnectorStyle`

| Value | Meaning |

| `Hidden` |  |
| `Straight` |  |
| `Elbow` |  |
| `Curved` |  |
| `Dashed` |  |

### enum `TimelineContentContainer`

Container drawn behind an item's title/body text.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Plain` | Bare text |
| `Card` | Filled rounded card |
| `OutlinedCard` | Outlined rounded card |
| `Bubble` | Filled circle (the Hanging design's default) |
